messages.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

### Wireless Communication market requirement → measurable parameter → Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability
| Market requirement / driver | Measurable parameter / test indicator | Required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5G FWA growth drivers include DSL replacement, work/schooling from home, government broadband plans, connecting the unconnected, holiday homes, and 5G launch. | Functional validation uses E2E max throughput DL/UL per band CA / ENDC / DC combos, 24/7 long-duration tests, NSA/SA attach, modulation, latency, authentication, firmware versioning, and heavy-load behavior. | The FWA solution overview lists VSG/VSA and R&S SMW200A / R&S FSW among the instruments for these FWA UE requirements. | [6][1] |
| Operators require RF TRX performance checks for FWA UE. | RF parametric indicators include NR 3GPP RF TRx test specification, output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity level BLER, band permutations, and carrier aggregations. | The same FWA requirement source lists VSG, VSA, R&S SMW200A, and R&S FSW as instruments, so the generator/analyzer chain must support 5G NR signal generation and vector/spectrum analysis for RF TRX measurements. | [1] |
| Regulatory approval is required for FWA UE. | Regulatory indicators include RF output power, emission mask, and spurious emissions for CE/FCC certification. | Transmitter conformance chapters require a spectrum analyzer and do not require a signal generator; 5G NR options on R&S FSW / R&S FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 and 9 measurements. | [1][17] |
| OTA antenna performance is required by operators for FWA UE. | OTA testing follows CTIA OTA test specification and verifies antenna performance. | OTA receiver testing sources list R&S SMW200A for 5G NR wanted signal and most interferer signals, and list spectrum analyzers such as R&S FSW for OTA receiver spurious emissions. | [1][59] |
| Receiver sensitivity / robustness must be verified in NR receiver testing. | Reference sensitivity is the minimum mean received power at which the specified reference measurement channel must meet the throughput requirement; each measured NR carrier must reach at least 95% of the reference measurement channel possible maximum throughput. | Receiver test setup uses R&S SMW200A with baseband generators, RF path A/B frequency options, AWGN option R&S SMW-K62, and 5G NR option R&S SMW-K144. | [11][16] |
| Blocking and intermodulation robustness must be verified in NR receiver testing. | Out-of-band blocking uses a CW interfering signal swept in 1 MHz steps, with wanted level equal to reference sensitivity + 6 dB; receiver intermodulation measures reception of the wanted signal in the presence of CW and QPSK-modulated NR interferers. | The signal generator capability must support wanted 5G NR signals plus CW / modulated interferers; sources state the CW interferer can be generated by SMW second path or an external CW generator, and intermodulation can use SMW second RF path or external generators such as R&S SGS100A / R&S SMA100B. | [13][12] |
| Spurious emissions from the receiver must be measured. | Receiver spurious emissions is a receiver test case measured with a signal / spectrum analyzer. | The source lists R&S FSW, R&S FSV3000, R&S FSVA3000, R&S FSV, R&S FSVA, and R&S FPS as usable analyzers for receiver spurious emissions. | [10][14] |
| 5G NR transmitter quality must be measured. | Conducted transmitter characteristics include base station output power, output power dynamics, transmit ON/OFF power, frequency error, modulation quality, time alignment error, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, operating band unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation. | These transmitter measurements are spectrum-analyzer-led; the SAN conformance summary states conducted and radiated transmitter chapters need a spectrum analyzer and do not require a signal generator. | [52][17] |
| High-frequency 5G / mmWave-related analysis may be required. | FSW43 is a signal and spectrum analyzer covering 2 Hz to 43.5 GHz; FSV3044 is a 44 GHz signal and spectrum analyzer with frequency range 10 Hz to 44 GHz. | Signal Analyzer capability therefore includes frequency coverage up to about 43.5–44 GHz for these listed analyzer models. | [29][32][35] |
| Wideband 5G NR signal generation may be required. | R&S SMW200A RF path A can cover 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B can cover up to 44 GHz, and the instrument can expand from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester. | Signal Generator capability includes 5G NR option R&S SMW-K144, optional multichannel/MIMO receiver-test architecture, and baseband bandwidth up to 160 MHz with standard baseband or 2 GHz with wideband baseband. | [21][25][28][22] |
【推論】A practical chain for 5G FWA is: market drivers such as DSL replacement and connecting the unconnected → operator/customer RF and functional requirements such as throughput, output power, EVM, OBW, BLER sensitivity, and latency → VSG/VSA capability using SMW200A for 5G NR stimulus and FSW-class analyzers for RF/spectrum measurements. [6][1][21][28][29]

5G FWA CPE deployment and testing requirements › 5G FWA UE test requirements
來源將 [[5G FWA]] UE test requirements 分成：

| 類別 | Indicators | Goal |
|---|---|---|
| RF parametric | NR 3GPP RF TRx test specification、Output power、EVM、OBW、receiver sensitivity level BLER、band permutations and CAs | Checks RF TRX performance in accordance with common test specifications；mostly required by operators |
| Functional | E2E max throughput DL / UL per band CA / ENDC / DC combos、24/7 long duration tests、NSA / SA attach、modulations <1024QAM、long connection stability、latency、SMS、USIM / eSIM authentication、FW versioning | Improve customer satisfaction；check battery life、thermal、firmware regression、wireless module benchmark、CPE under heavy load |
| Operator acceptance | Operator-specific test criteria | Verifies whether device meets operator test criteria |
| Conformance | RF / RRM / PCT | [[GCF]] / [[PTCRB]] certification |
| OTA | [[CTIA]] OTA test specification | Verifies antenna performance，required by operators |
| Coexistence | WLAN coexistence testing with Wi‑Fi signaling | Ensure no impact between different radios |
| Security | TCP/IP application message flows | SW vulnerability testing |
| Regulatory | RF output power、emission mask、spurious emissions | CE / FCC certification |

來源列出的 instruments 包含 Power Supply、Power Meters、Scopes、VSA、VSG、[[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S NGM200]]。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

5G FWA CPE deployment and testing requirements › Outdoor CPE characteristics
來源描述 [[Outdoor CPE]]：

- Contains LTE / NR modem。
- 通常透過 Ethernet 連接 separate indoor residential gateway。
- Requires professional installation and setup。
- Commonly required for High-Band scenarios。

Advantages：reliable and predictable QoS、supports large cell radius especially with good LoS to base station、supports highest data rates。

Disadvantages：requires professional installation and setup、requires suitable outdoor location with LoS or nLoS to base station、higher costs。

- Intermodulation response rejection 衡量 receiver 在 two interfering signals 存在下於 assigned channel frequency 接收 wanted signal 的能力。

5G NR Base Station Conformance Testing › Measurement uncertainty 與 calibration
依 [[5G NR Base station conformance testing - EN - UR_Public]]（2023-06）：

- Conducted measurement uncertainties and test requirements 引用 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] section 4.1.2。
- Transmitter tests 範例：6.2 Base Station output power、6.5.2 EVM、6.5.3 Time alignment error。
- Receiver tests 範例：7.2 Reference sensitivity level。
- Performance requirements 範例：PUSCH、PUCCH、PRACH with fading channel。
- OTA test system acceptable uncertainty 在 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] chapter 4.1.2 指定；test requirement combines MU and minimum requirement。
- OTA uncertainty contributors 摘錄自 [[3GPP TR 37.843]]，包含 probe position、probe pattern knowledge、measurement distance、multiple reflections、mismatch of receiver chain、absolute gain of probe antenna、measurement repeatability / positioning repeatability。
- OTA measurement chamber specific calibration procedures captured in [[3GPP TR 37.843]]。
- FR2 OTA test requirements specific and chamber specific calibration procedures are for further study（FFS），potential reuse of FR1 calibration procedures for FR2 is FFS。
- Calibration measurements with SMW / FSW 可使用 reference antenna gain comparison 或 gain transfer method；SMW 與 FSW 可用 K544 user defined frequency correction / User-Corr.。

3GPP TS 38.141-2 › OTA uncertainty 與 calibration
依 [[5G NR Base station conformance testing - EN - UR_Public]]（2023-06）：

- Maximum acceptable uncertainty is specified for each radiated test（Chapter 4.1.2）。
- Test requirement combines MU and minimum requirement。
- 來源範例為 BS type 2-O normal conditions 的 OTA base station output power。
- Additional uncertainty contributors 摘錄自 [[3GPP TR 37.843]]，包含 probe position、probe pattern knowledge、measurement distance、multiple reflections、receiver chain mismatch、probe antenna absolute gain、measurement repeatability / positioning repeatability。
- OTA measurement chamber specific calibration procedures captured in [[3GPP TR 37.843]]。
- FR2 calibration procedures in some areas are for further study（FFS）。

依 [[GFM324_1e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_TX_Tests]]（06.2020）：

- OTA system 必須在測試前校準。
- Calibration 使用 SMW-K544 與 FSW-K544 user defined frequency response correction options。
- System loss 包含 cable losses、antenna losses、OTA losses 等。
- Calibration 流程包含 sweep CW signal、measure received power、create attenuation table、apply attenuation table and reference antenna gain table to K544。

3GPP TS 38.141-2 › OTA Tx requirement classification
依 [[GFM324_1e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_TX_Tests]]（06.2020）：

- Radiated transmit power 使用 [[EIRP]]，classification 為 directional。
- OTA BS output power 使用 [[TRP]]，classification 為 TRP。
- OTA output power dynamics classification 為 directional。
- OTA transmit OFF power：FR1 為 co-location，FR2 為 TRP。
- OTA transient period：FR1 為 co-location，FR2 為 directional。
- OTA transmitted signal quality classification 為 directional。
- OTA occupied bandwidth classification 為 directional。
- OTA ACLR classification 為 TRP。
- OTA operating band unwanted emissions classification 為 TRP。
- OTA transmitter spurious emission classification 為 TRP，FR1 co-location requirements 例外。
- OTA transmitter intermodulation classification 為 co-location，且 FR2 未定義 requirement。

3GPP TS 38.141-2 › Chapter 6 radiated transmitter characteristics
依 [[5G NR Base station conformance testing - EN - UR_Public]]（2023-06），`Tests according to 3GPP TS 38.141-2 v17.5 Chapter 6` 表中列出：

- 6.2 Radiated transmit power。
- 6.3 OTA Base station output power。
- 6.4.2 OTA RE power control dynamic range。
- 6.4.3 OTA total power dynamic range。
- 6.5.1 OTA transmitter OFF power。
- 6.5.2 OTA transmitter transient period。
- 6.6.2 OTA transmitted signal quality - OTA frequency error。
- 6.6.3 OTA transmitted signal quality - OTA modulation quality。
- 6.6.4 OTA transmitted signal quality - OTA time alignment error。
- 6.7.2 OTA unwanted emissions - OTA occupied bandwidth。
- 6.7.3 OTA Adjacent Channel Leakage Power Ratio（ACLR）。
- 6.7.4 OTA operating band unwanted emissions。
- 6.7.5 OTA transmitter spurious emissions。
- 6.8 OTA transmitter intermodulation。

依 [[GFM324_1e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_TX_Tests]]（06.2020），Release 16 V16.3.0 的 Chapter 6 single carrier test coverage 更細分為：

- 6.7.5.2 General OTA transmitter spurious emissions。
- 6.7.5.3 Protection of the base station receiver of own or different base station。
- 6.7.5.4 Additional spurious emissions requirements。
- 6.7.5.5 Co-location requirements。

GFM324 也說 6.8 OTA transmitter intermodulation 不適用於 BS type 2-O。

3GPP TS 38.141-2 › Chapter 7 radiated receiver characteristics
依 [[5G NR Base station conformance testing - EN - UR_Public]]（2023-06），`Tests according to 3GPP TS 38.141-2 v17.5 Chapter 7` 表中列出：

- 7.2 OTA sensitivity。
- 7.3 OTA reference sensitivity level。
- 7.4 OTA Dynamic Range。
- 7.5.1 OTA Adjacent Channel Selectivity（ACS）。
- 7.5.2 OTA In-band blocking。
- 7.6 OTA Out-of-band blocking。
- 7.7 OTA Receiver spurious emissions。
- 7.8 OTA Receiver intermodulation。
- 7.9 OTA In-channel selectivity。

表格用 wanted signal、AWGN、modulated interferer、CW interferer 描述各測試所需信號類型。

GFM324 不涵蓋 Chapter 7；來源指出 Base station RF receiver tests 另見 GFM325。

GFM325_0e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_RX_Tests › R&S 測試方案與儀器
來源列出的 OTA antenna test solutions：

- [[R&S TS8991]] OTA Performance Test System with WPTC test chamber：FR1、FR2。
- [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR based 5G NR mmWave test chamber：FR2。
- [[R&S PWC200]] Plane Wave Converter，可選擇 shielded in a WPTC test chamber：FR1。

來源列出的主要儀器與 options：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] vector signal generator，用於 5G NR wanted signal 與多數 interferer signal。
- [[R&S SMW-K144]]：5G New Radio software option。
- [[R&S SMW-K544]]：user defined frequency response correction，用於 OTA calibration。
- [[R&S FSW-K544]]：user defined frequency response correction，用於 OTA calibration。
- 7.6 OTA out-of-band blocking 需要額外 CW signal generator，建議 [[R&S SMA100B]] 搭配 [[R&S SMAB-B167]]，頻率範圍 8 kHz to 67 GHz。
- 7.7 OTA receiver spurious emissions 需要 spectrum analyzer，可用 [[R&S FSW]]、R&S FSV、R&S FSVA、[[R&S FSV3000]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、R&S FPS。

Ordering information 摘要：

- [[R&S TS8991]]：OTA Performance Test System，Order No. 1119.4309.02；includes WPTC test chambers。
- [[R&S ATS1800C]]：Compact antenna test range OTA test system，Order No. 1534.1800.02。
- [[R&S PWC200]]：Plane Wave Converter，Order No. 1532.3006.02。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：Vector signal generator，Order No. 1412.0000.02。
- R&S SMW frequency options listed：SMW-B1031 / B1040 / B1044；Order No. 1428.5307.02 / 1428.8506.02 / 1428.5507.02。
- [[R&S SMW-K144]]：5G New Radio，Order No. 1414.4990.02。
- [[R&S SMW-K62]]：Additional white Gaussian noise，Order No. 1413.3484.02。
- [[R&S SMA100B]]：Signal generator，Order No. 1419.8888.02。
- [[R&S SMAB-B167]]：Frequency option 8 kHz to 67 GHz，Order No. 1420.9149.02。
- [[R&S FSW67]]：Signal and spectrum analyzer，Order No. 1331.5003.67。

來源明示 ordering information 表格未包含 5G NR base station conformance testing 所需的全部 test instruments 與 system components。

GFM325_0e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_RX_Tests › 7.6 OTA out-of-band blocking
- 衡量 receiver unit 在 [[RIB]] assigned channel 接收 wanted signal，同時存在 unwanted interferer 的能力。
- 需要 CW interfering signal，可由 external CW generator（例如 [[R&S SMA100B]]）產生。
- BS type 1-O：wanted signal mean power EIS + 6 dB；interfering signal RMS field-strength 0.36 V/m；interfering signal type CW。
- BS type 2-O：不同 frequency range 使用 0.36 V/m 或 0.10 V/m field-strength。
- Co-location blocking 僅適用於 [[BS type 1-O]]，使用 CLTA 注入 CW interferer。

GFM325_0e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_RX_Tests › 7.7 OTA receiver spurious emissions
- 定義：receiver unit 從 antenna array 輻射出的 emissions power。
- FDD BS 不適用 OTA RX spurious emissions requirement，因為 OTA domain 中無法區分 Tx 與 Rx spurious emissions；TDD BS 只在 transmitter OFF period 適用。
- FR1 limits 適用 30 MHz to 12.75 GHz；FR2 limits 適用 30 MHz to downlink operating band upper frequency edge 的 2nd harmonic。
- Detection mode：True RMS。
- Measurement 使用 spectrum analyzer，例如 [[R&S FSW]]。
- 使用 directional measurements 計算每個 specified frequency 的 [[TRP]]。

GFM325_0e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_RX_Tests › 7.9 OTA in-channel selectivity
- ICS 衡量 receiver 在存在較高 power spectral density 干擾訊號時，於指定 resource block locations 接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- Test purpose：驗證 BS receiver 抑制 IQ leakage 的能力。
- Throughput requirement：大於或等於 reference measurement channel maximum throughput 的 95%。
- 來源列出 BS type 1-O Wide area / Medium range / Local area 與 BS type 2-O 的 wanted signal mean power、interfering signal mean power、SCS、FRC 與 RB 數。

GFM325_0e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_RX_Tests › Receiver test 分類重點
依來源的 radiated receiver requirements classification：

- OTA sensitivity：Directional；基於 OSDD；conformance testing 針對 5 個 directions；不適用於 [[BS type 2-O]]。
- OTA reference sensitivity level：Directional；針對 manufacturer 宣告的 5 個 directions。
- OTA dynamic range：Directional；wanted signal 與 interfering signal 來自相同方向；不適用於 [[BS type 2-O]]。
- OTA in-band selectivity and blocking：Directional；在 minSENS OSDD reference direction 與 OTA REFSENS RoAoA extremities 測試。
- OTA out-of-band blocking：Directional；但 [[BS type 1-O]] 另有 co-location requirement。
- OTA receiver spurious emission：TRP；因 spurious region radiation pattern unknown。
- OTA receiver intermodulation：Directional；只需 single direction。
- OTA in-channel selectivity：Directional；single direction。

一般規則：

- Requirements apply during base station receive period。
- Requirements shall be met for any transmitter setting。
- FDD operation 中，requirements shall be met with transmitter unit(s) ON。
- Radiated receiver characteristics 的 throughput requirements 不假設 HARQ retransmissions。

GFM325_0e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_RX_Tests › 7.2 OTA sensitivity
- 目的：驗證 BS 能在 OSDD 宣告的 EIS level 與 angles of arrival range 下，對 specified measurement channel 達成 throughput requirement。
- 不適用於 [[BS type 2-O]]；來源說 BS type 2-O 的 OTA sensitivity 與 OTA reference sensitivity 相同。
- Throughput requirement：每個 measured carrier 的 throughput measured 必須大於或等於 reference measurement channel maximum throughput 的 95%。

### Wireless Communication market requirement → measurable parameter → Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability
| Market requirement / driver | Measurable parameter / test indicator | Required Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5G FWA growth drivers include DSL replacement, work/schooling from home, government broadband plans, connecting the unconnected, holiday homes, and 5G launch. | Functional validation uses E2E max throughput DL/UL per band CA / ENDC / DC combos, 24/7 long-duration tests, NSA/SA attach, modulation, latency, authentication, firmware versioning, and heavy-load behavior. | The FWA solution overview lists VSG/VSA and R&S SMW200A / R&S FSW among the instruments for these FWA UE requirements. | [6][1] |
| Operators require RF TRX performance checks for FWA UE. | RF parametric indicators include NR 3GPP RF TRx test specification, output power, EVM, OBW, receiver sensitivity level BLER, band permutations, and carrier aggregations. | The same FWA requirement source lists VSG, VSA, R&S SMW200A, and R&S FSW as instruments, so the generator/analyzer chain must support 5G NR signal generation and vector/spectrum analysis for RF TRX measurements. | [1] |
| Regulatory approval is required for FWA UE. | Regulatory indicators include RF output power, emission mask, and spurious emissions for CE/FCC certification. | Transmitter conformance chapters require a spectrum analyzer and do not require a signal generator; 5G NR options on R&S FSW / R&S FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 and 9 measurements. | [1][17] |
| OTA antenna performance is required by operators for FWA UE. | OTA testing follows CTIA OTA test specification and verifies antenna performance. | OTA receiver testing sources list R&S SMW200A for 5G NR wanted signal and most interferer signals, and list spectrum analyzers such as R&S FSW for OTA receiver spurious emissions. | [1][59] |
| Receiver sensitivity / robustness must be verified in NR receiver testing. | Reference sensitivity is the minimum mean received power at which the specified reference measurement channel must meet the throughput requirement; each measured NR carrier must reach at least 95% of the reference measurement channel possible maximum throughput. | Receiver test setup uses R&S SMW200A with baseband generators, RF path A/B frequency options, AWGN option R&S SMW-K62, and 5G NR option R&S SMW-K144. | [11][16] |
| Blocking and intermodulation robustness must be verified in NR receiver testing. | Out-of-band blocking uses a CW interfering signal swept in 1 MHz steps, with wanted level equal to reference sensitivity + 6 dB; receiver intermodulation measures reception of the wanted signal in the presence of CW and QPSK-modulated NR interferers. | The signal generator capability must support wanted 5G NR signals plus CW / modulated interferers; sources state the CW interferer can be generated by SMW second path or an external CW generator, and intermodulation can use SMW second RF path or external generators such as R&S SGS100A / R&S SMA100B. | [13][12] |
| Spurious emissions from the receiver must be measured. | Receiver spurious emissions is a receiver test case measured with a signal / spectrum analyzer. | The source lists R&S FSW, R&S FSV3000, R&S FSVA3000, R&S FSV, R&S FSVA, and R&S FPS as usable analyzers for receiver spurious emissions. | [10][14] |
| 5G NR transmitter quality must be measured. | Conducted transmitter characteristics include base station output power, output power dynamics, transmit ON/OFF power, frequency error, modulation quality, time alignment error, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, operating band unwanted emissions, spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation. | These transmitter measurements are spectrum-analyzer-led; the SAN conformance summary states conducted and radiated transmitter chapters need a spectrum analyzer and do not require a signal generator. | [52][17] |
| High-frequency 5G / mmWave-related analysis may be required. | FSW43 is a signal and spectrum analyzer covering 2 Hz to 43.5 GHz; FSV3044 is a 44 GHz signal and spectrum analyzer with frequency range 10 Hz to 44 GHz. | Signal Analyzer capability therefore includes frequency coverage up to about 43.5–44 GHz for these listed analyzer models. | [29][32][35] |
| Wideband 5G NR signal generation may be required. | R&S SMW200A RF path A can cover 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B can cover up to 44 GHz, and the instrument can expand from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester. | Signal Generator capability includes 5G NR option R&S SMW-K144, optional multichannel/MIMO receiver-test architecture, and baseband bandwidth up to 160 MHz with standard baseband or 2 GHz with wideband baseband. | [21][25][28][22] |
【推論】A practical chain for 5G FWA is: market drivers such as DSL replacement and connecting the unconnected → operator/customer RF and functional requirements such as throughput, output power, EVM, OBW, BLER sensitivity, and latency → VSG/VSA capability using SMW200A for 5G NR stimulus and FSW-class analyzers for RF/spectrum measurements. [6][1][21][28][29]

Receiver spurious emissions test case 7.6 不需要 signal generator，但需要 signal and spectrum analyzer；來源列出可用 analyzers：

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.2 Reference Sensitivity Level
- `PREFSENS` 是 BS type 1-C 在 antenna connector、或 BS type 1-H 在 TAB connector 接收的 minimum mean power。
- 在此功率下，specified reference measurement channel 必須滿足 throughput requirement。
- 每個 measured NR carrier 的 throughput 必須 ≥ reference measurement channel possible maximum throughput 的 95%。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC72`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.7 Receiver Intermodulation
- Intermodulation response rejection 衡量 receiver 在 two interfering signals 存在下於 assigned channel frequency 接收 wanted signal 的能力。
- Interfering signals 是 CW signal 與 QPSK modulation 的 NR signal。
- NR interferer 在 baseband B 產生；CW interferer 可由 SMW second RF path 的 `AWGN B` block 產生，或由 external signal generator 產生，例如 [[R&S SGS100A]] 或 [[R&S SMA100B]]。
- General intermodulation interferer levels：Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- Narrow-band intermodulation interferer levels 同樣為 Wide area -52.0 dBm；Medium range -47.0 dBm；Local area -44.0 dBm。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC77`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.5 Out-of-band Blocking

- 掃頻範圍來源中列為 1 MHz 到 12.75 GHz；另有一處文字列為 1 MHz 到 12.57 GHz，需回原文確認。
- Wanted level = [[3GPP TS 38.104]] reference sensitivity level + 6 dB。
- Interfering signal mean power：Blocking performance -15.0 dBm；Co-located base station 16.0 dBm。
- CW interferer 可由 SMW second path 或 external CW generator 提供。
- SCPI test case：`:BB:NR5G:TCW:TC TS381411_TC75`。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › Test setup 與 SMW options
來源描述一般 receiver test setup 包含：

- Base station DUT。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]（SMW）。
- [[R&S FSW]]（FSW）。
- diplexer / notch filter / frequency filter。

Receiver characteristics tests 需要的 SMW equipment / options：

- 2× option baseband generator：`R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 1× option baseband main module：`R&S®SMW-B13T` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13XT`。
- 1× RF path A frequency option，例如 `R&S®SMW-B1007`。
- 1× RF path B frequency option，例如 `R&S®SMW-B2007`。
- 1× additive white Gaussian noise option：`R&S®SMW-K62`。
- 2× digital standard 5G NR option：`R&S®SMW-K144`。

來源的 ordering information 另列：

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › Signal routing and baseband main module
| Code | Name / description | Order No. | 原文說明 / 限制 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `R&S®SMW-B13` | Signal routing and baseband main module，one I/Q path to RF section | `1413.2807.02` | Standard baseband section；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13T` | Signal routing and baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.3003.02` | Standard baseband section；若要安裝 RF path B 需 `B13T` 或 `B13XT`；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13XT` | Wideband baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.8005.02` | Wideband baseband section；RF modulation bandwidth up to `2 GHz`。 |

- Standard baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13T`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `160 MHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B10` standard baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B14` fading simulator。
- Wideband baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13XT`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B9` / `R&S®SMW-B9F` wideband baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B15` fading simulator and signal processor。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital standards、R&S WinIQSIM2、Pulse Sequencer、MIMO 與 fading
- Internal digital modulation systems 至少需安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 來源列出 cellular、wireless connectivity、navigation、broadcast 與 other standards options；包含 `GSM/EDGE`、`3GPP FDD`、`LTE Release 8` 到 `Release 15`、`Cellular IoT`、`5G New Radio`、`5G NR Release 16/17`、`IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`Bluetooth EDR/5.x/5.4`、`GNSS`、`DVB-S2/S2X`、`DVB-RCS2`、`LoRa`、`HRP UWB` 等。
- 來源描述 digital standards 不需要 separate PC software；但 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] 另明列 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。判斷：前者指 instrument internal digital standards，後者指 WinIQSIM2 workflow，不合併為單一規則。
- `R&S®SMW-K144`：5G New Radio，Order No. `1414.4990.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K145`：5G New Radio closed-loop BS test，Order No. `1414.6506.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K148`：5G NR Release 16，Order No. `1414.6664.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K170`：5G NR sidelink，Order No. `1413.8640.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K171`：5G NR Release 17，Order No. `1413.7280.02`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC；`R&S®SMW-K200` waveform packages 可登錄 1、5 或 50 waveforms，每台 instrument 最多 `250 waveforms`。
- [[R&S Pulse Sequencer]] 相關 options 包含 `R&S®SMW-K300`、`K301`、`K302`、`K304`、`K306`、`K307`、`K308`、`K315`、`K350`。
- Multichannel、MIMO and fading 完整規格另見 `PD 3673.1276.22`；digital standards 完整規格另見 `PD 5213.9434.22`；GNSS/avionics 另見 `PD 3607.6896.22`；Pulse Sequencer 另見 `PD 3607.1388.22`。

R&S FSW43
R&S FSW43 是 [[R&S FSW]] 系列 2 Hz to 43.5 GHz Signal and Spectrum Analyzer，Order No. 1331.5003.43。

R&S FSV3044
R&S FSV3044 是 [[R&S FSV3000]] 系列 44 GHz Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 型號，依 [[FSV3000_specs_en_5216-1334-22_v1601]]（Version 16.01，August 2025）整理。
